captures.description: THE LUDDITE LAB, BY NAME, ON GOOGLE'S AI OVERVIEW, SIGNED OUT, 2026-10-29: 'The Luddite Lab (formally known as the Luddite Lab Resource Hub) is a project by the Distributed AI Research Institute (DAIR) designed to help unions, labor organizations, and workers resist AI and workplace automation.' Purpose, its reframing of AI job displacement as a management choice, its leadership (Alex Hanna), access, and a note that Luddite Labs, a commercial developer-tools company, is unrelated. Seven cards: DAIR's two pages, AI Weekly, LinkedIn, Buttondown, Luddite Labs, a video.
